A seed is NOT an integration: accessState stays 'unverified' until evidence is recorded. Aliases/duplicates are resolved by setting aliasOf — never by deleting an entry. Websites resolved 2026-09-30: identity, domain, parent, category, pricing model, API/export signal. accessState is our CURRENT authorised path, not the site's openness: paid -> permission_required; free/freemium -> manual_import_only until a terms review is recorded.
